text: Huroof-e-Muqatta'at ki behas Surah Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein guzar chuki hai. Imtehan aur Momin phir farmata hai yeh namumkin hai ke mominon ko bhi imtehan se chhor diya jaye. Sahih hadith mein hai ke sab se zyada sakht imtehan nabiyon ka hota hai phir saleh nek logon ka phir un se kam darje wale phir un se kam darje wale. Insaan ka imtehan us ke deen ke andaz par hota hai agar woh apne deen mein sakht hai to musibatein bhi sakht nazil hoti hain. Isi mazmoon ka bayan is ayat mein bhi hai (Am hasibtum an tutraku wa lamma ya'lamillahu alladhina jahadu minkum wa la yattakhidhu min duniillahi wa la rasulihi wa lal mu'minina walijah, wallahu khabirum bima ta'malun) (Surah At-Tawbah: 16). Kya tum ne yeh guman kar liya hai ke tum chhor diye jaoge? Halan-ke abhi Allah Ta'ala ne yeh zahir nahin kiya ke tum mein se mujahid kaun hai? Aur sabir kaun hai? Isi tarah Surah Barat aur Surah Baqarah mein bhi guzar chuka hai ke kya tum ne yeh soch rakha hai ke tum jannat mein yunhi chale jaoge? Aur agle logon jaise sakht imtehan ke mauqe tum par na ayenge. Jaise ke unhein bhook, dukh, dard waghera pahunche. Yahan tak ke rasool aur un ke sath ke imandar bol uthe ke Allah ki madad kahan hai? Yaqin mano ke Allah ki madad qareeb hai. Yahan bhi farmaya un se agle musalmanon ki bhi jaanch partaal ki gayi unhein bhi sard-o-garm chakhaya gaya taake jo apne da'we mein sache hain aur jo sirf zabani da'we karte hain un mein tameez ho jaye. Is se yeh na samjha jaye ke Allah ise janta na tha, woh har ho chuki baat ko aur hone wali baat ko barabar janta hai. Is par Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ke tamam imamon ka ijma hai. Pas yahan ilm ru'yat yani dekhne ke ma'ne mein hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) 'li-na'lama' ke ma'ne 'li-nara' karte hain kyunke dekhne ka ta'alluq maujood cheezon se hota hai aur ilm us se aam hai. Phir farmaya hai jo iman nahin laye woh bhi yeh guman na karein ke imtehan se bach jayenge, bade bade azab aur sakht sazayein un ki taak mein hain. Yeh hath se nikal nahin sakte, hum se aage barh nahin sakte, un ke yeh guman nihayat bure hain jin ka bura natija yeh anqareeb dekh lenge.

Nekiyon ki koshish: Jinhein Aakhirat ke badlon ki umeed hai aur use samne rakh kar woh nekiyan karte hain. Un ki umeedein poori hongi aur unhein na khatam hone wale sawab milenge. Allah duaon ka sunne wala aur kul kainat ka janne wala hai, Allah ka thahraya hua waqt talta nahin. Phir farmata hai har nek amal karne wala apna hi nafa karta hai. Allah Ta'ala bandon ke aamal se be-parwah hai. Agar sare insaan muttaqi ban jayen to Allah ki saltanat mein koi izafa nahin ho sakta. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain jihad talwar chalane ka hi naam nahin. Insaan nekiyon ki koshish mein laga hai yeh bhi ek tarah ka jihad hai. Is mein shak nahin ke tumhari nekiyan Allah ke kisi kaam nahin aatin lekin baharhal us ki yeh meherbani hai ke woh tumhein nekiyon par badle deta hai. Un ki wajah se tumhari buraiyan maaf farma deta hai. Chhoti se chhoti neki ki qadr karta hai aur us par bade se bada ajr deta hai, ek ek neki ka saat saat sau guna badla inayat farmata hai aur badi ko ya to bilkul hi maaf farma deta hai ya usi ke barabar saza deta hai. Woh zulm se paak hai, gunahon se darguzar kar leta hai aur un ke achhe aamal ka badal ata farmata hai.

Insaan ka wajood pehle apni Tauheed par mazbooti ke sath karband rehne ka hukum farma kar ab maa baap ke sulook-o-ehsan ka hukum deta hai. Kyunke inhi se insaan ka wajood hota hai. Baap kharch karta hai aur parwarish karta hai, maa mohabbat rakhti hai aur paalti hai. Dusri aayat mein farman hai aayat (وَقَضٰى رَبُّكَ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْٓا اِلَّآ اِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ اِحْسَانًا 23؀) (17-Al-Isra: 23) Allah Ta'ala faisla farma chuka hai ke tum us ke siwa kisi aur ki ibadat na karo aur maa baap ki poori itaat karo. In dono ya in mein se ek ka budhape ka zamana aa jaye to unhein 'uff' bhi na kehna, daant dupt to kahan ki? Balkeh un ke sath adab se kalam karna aur raham ke sath un ke samne jhuke rehna aur Allah se un ke liye dua karna, kaha: Aye Allah! In par aisa raham kar jaise yeh bachpan mein mujh par kiya karte thay. Lekin haan yeh khayal rahe ke agar yeh shirk ki taraf bulayen to un ka kaha na manna. Samajh lo ke tumhein ek din mere samne khade hona hai. Us waqt main apni parastish ka aur mere farman ke tahet maa baap ki itaat karne ka badla dunga. Aur nek logon ke sath hashr karunga. Agar tum ne apne maa baap ki woh baatein nahin maani jo mere ahkaam ke khilaf nahin to woh khwah kaise hi hon main tumhein un se alag kar lunga. Kyunke Qayamat ke din insaan us ke sath hoga jise woh duniya mein chahta tha. Isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke imaan walon aur nek amal walon ko main apne saleh bandon mein mila dunga. Hazrat Saad (R.A) farmate hain mere bare mein chaar aayatein utrin jin mein se ek aayat yeh bhi hai. Yeh is liye utri ke meri maa ne mujh se kaha ke aye Saad! Kya Allah ka hukum mere sath neki karne ka nahin? Agar tu ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwat se inkar na kiya to wallah main khana peena chhod dungi. Chunancha us ne yahi kiya yahan tak ke log zabardasti us ka munh khol kar ghiza halq mein pahuncha dete thay, pas yeh aayat utri. (Tirmidhi waghera)

Murtad hone wale un munafiqon ka zikr ho raha hai jo zabani iman ka dawa kar lete hain lekin jahan mukhalifeen ki taraf se koi dukh pahuncha ke yeh use Allah ka azab samajh kar murtad ho jate hain. Yehi mani Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera ne kiye hain jaise aur ayat mein hai (Waminannasi may-ya'budullaha 'ala harfin) (Surah Al-Hajj: 11) yani ba'az log ek kinare khade ho kar Allah ki ibadat karte hain agar rahat mili to mutma'in ho gaye aur agar musibat pahunchi to munh pher liya. Yahan bayan ho raha hai ke agar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko koi ghanimat mili koi fath mili to apna dindar hona zahir karne lagte hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Allazina yatarabbasuna bikum fa-in kana lakum fathum minallahi qalu alam nakum ma'akum wa-in kana lilkafirina nasibun) (Surah An-Nisa: 141) woh tumhein dekhte rehte hain agar fath-o-nusrat hui to hank lagane lagte hain ke kya hum tumhare sath nahin hain? Aur agar kafiron ki ban aayi to un se apni saaz jatane lagte hain ke dekho hum ne tumhara sath diya aur tumhein bacha liya. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya bahut mumkin hai ke Allah apne bandon ko bilkul hi ghalib kar de phir to yeh apni is chupi hui harkat par saaf nadim ho jayenge. Yahan farmaya ke yeh kya baat hai kya unhein itna bhi nahin maloom ke Allah 'Alim-ul-Ghaib hai. Woh jahan zabani baat janta hai wahan qalbi baat bhi use maloom hai. Allah Ta'ala bhulaiyan buraiyan pahuncha kar nek-o-bad ko momin-o-munafiq ko alag alag kar dega. Nafs ke parastar nafa ke khwahan yaksu ho jayenge aur nafa nuqsan mein iman ko na chhodne wale zahir ho jayenge. Jaise farmaya (Walanabluwannakum hatta na'lamal-mujahidina minkum was-sabirina wanabluwa akhbarakum) (Surah Muhammad: 31) hum tumhein azmate raha karenge yahan tak ke tum mein se mujahideen ko aur sabireen ko hum duniya ke samne zahir kar dein aur tumhari khabrein dekh bhal lein. Uhud ke imtehan ka zikr kar ke farmaya ke Allah mominon ko jis halat par woh the rakhne wala na tha jab ke khabis-o-tayyib ki tamiz na karein.

Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ) ki hosla afzai is mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ki tasalli hai. Aap ko khabar di jati hai ke Nuh (A.S) itni lambi muddat tak apni qoum ko Allah ki taraf bulate rahe. Aakhir-kaar Allah ka ghazab un par ba-surat-e-toofan aaya aur unhein tehas-nehas kar diya. Toh ae Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman aap apni qoum ki is takzeeb ko naya khayal na karein. Aap apne dil ko ranjeeda na karein, hidayat-o-zalalat Allah ke haath mein hai. Jin logon ka jahannam mein jana tay ho chuka hai unhein toh koi bhi hidayat nahin de sakta. Tamam nishaniyan go dekh lein lekin unhein iman naseeb nahin hone ka. Bil-aakhir jaise Nuh (A.S) ko nijat mili aur qoum doob gayi isi tarah aakhir mein ghalba aap ka hai aur aap ke mukhalifeen past honge. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke chalees saal ki umar mein Nuh (A.S) ko nabuwwat mili aur nabuwwat ke baad saarhay nau sau saal tak aap ne apni qoum ko tableegh ki. Toofan ki aalamgeer halakat ke baad bhi Nuh (A.S) saath saal tak zinda rahe yahan tak ke Bani-e-Adam ki nasl phail gayi aur duniya mein yeh ba-kasrat nazar aane lage. Qatadah farmate hain Nuh (A.S) ki umar kul saarhay nau sau saal ki thi, teen sau saal toh aap ke ba-dawat un mein guzre, teen sau saal tak Allah ki taraf apni qoum ko bulaya aur saarhay teen sau saal baad-e-toofan ke zinda rahe, lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai aur aayat ke zahir alfaaz se toh yahi maloom hota hai ke aap saarhay nau sau saal tak apni qoum ko Allah ki wahdaniyat ki taraf bulate rahe. Awn bin Abi Shaddad kehte hain ke jab aap ki umar saarhay teen sau saal ki thi us waqt Allah ki wahi aap ko aayi, us ke baad saarhay nau sau saal tak aap logon ko Allah ki taraf bulate rahe, us ke baad phir saarhay teen sau saal ki umar aur payi. Lekin yeh bhi ghareeb qaul hai. Zyada durust qaul Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul nazar aata hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne Mujahid se poocha ke Nuh (A.S) apni qoum mein kitni muddat tak rahe? Unhon ne kaha saarhay nau sau saal. Aap ne farmaya ke us ke baad se logon ke akhlaq, un ki umrein aur aqlein aaj tak ghat-ti hi chali aayin. Jab qoum-e-Nuh par Allah ka ghazab nazil hua toh Allah Ta'ala ne apne fazl-o-karam se apne Nabi ko aur iman walon ko jo aap ke hukum se toofan se pehle kashti mein sawar ho chuke thay bacha liya. Surah Hud mein is ki tafseel guzar chuki hai is liye yahan dobara warid nahin karte. Hum ne is kashti ko duniya ke liye nishan bana diya, ya toh khud is kashti ko jaise Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) ka qaul hai ke awwal-e-Islam tak woh Judi pahar par thi. Ya yeh ke kashti ko dekh kar phir pani ke safar ke liye jo kashtiyan logon ne banayin un ko unhein dekh kar Allah ka woh bachana yaad aa jata hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Waa-ayatul-lahum anna hamalna zurriyyatahum fil-fulkil mashhoon) (36. Yaseen: 41) hamari qudrat ki nishani un ke liye yeh bhi hai ke hum ne un ki nasl ko bhari hui kashti mein bitha diya.

Aur hum ne un ke liye aur isi jaisi sawariyan bana dein. Surah Al-Haqqah mein farmaya jab pani ka toofan aaya to hum ne tumhein kashti mein bitha liya. Aur un ka zikr tumhare liye yaadgar bana diya taake jin kaanon ko Allah ne yaad ki taqat di hai woh yaad rakh lein. Yahan shakhs se jins ki taraf charhao kiya hai. Jaise aayat (Walaqad zayyannas sama'ad dunya bimasaabeeha waja'alnaha rujooman lish-shayateeni wa a'tadna lahum azabas sa'eer) (67. Al-Mulk: 5) wali aayat mein hai ke aasman-e-dunya ke sitaron ka ba'is-e-zeenat aasman hona bayan farma kar un ki wazahat mein shihab ka shaitanon ke liye rajam hona bayan farmaya hai. Aur aayat mein insan ke mitti se paida hone ka zikr kar ke farmaya hai phir hum ne use nutfay ki shakal mein qarargah mein kar diya. Haan yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat mein 'ha' ki zameer ka marja' uqoobat aur saza ko kiya jaye wallahu a'lam. (Yahan yeh khayal rahe ke Tafsir Ibn Kathir ke ba'az nuskho mein shuru-e-tafsir mein kuch ibarat zyada hai jo ba'az nuskho mein nahin hai. Woh yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Nuh A.S ka saarhay nau sau saal tak aazmaya jana bayan kiya aur un ke qaul ko un ki ita'at ke sath aazmana batlaya ke un ki takzeeb ki wajah se Allah ne unhein gharq kar diya. Phir us ke baad jala diya. Phir qaum-e-Ibrahim A.S ki aazmaish ka zikr kiya ke unhon ne bhi ita'at-o-mutaba'at na ki phir Lut A.S ki aazmaish ka zikr kiya aur un ki qaum ka hashr bayan farmaya. Phir Hazrat Shuaib A.S ki qaum ke waqiat samne rakhe phir Aadiyon, Thamudiyon, Qaruniyon, Firauniyon, Hamaniyon waghera ka zikr kiya ke Allah par iman lane aur us ki tauheed ko na manne ki wajah se unhein bhi tarah tarah ki sazayein di gayin. Isi mazmoon ko aur jagah farmaya ke wahi nayi paidaish mein paida karta hai wahi dobara paida karega aur yeh to is par bohat aasaan hai. Ya woh aasman-o-zameen ke khaliq hain? Kuch nahin be-yaqeen log hain. Yeh Allah ki shaan hai ke jise chahe azab kare jis par chahe raham kare woh hakim hai qabze wala hai jo chahta hai karta hai jo irada karta hai jari kardeta hai. Koi us ke hukum ko taal nahin sakta koi us ke irade ko badal nahin sakta. Koi us se choon chara nahin kar sakta koi us se sawal nahin kar sakta aur woh sab par ghalib hai. Jis se chahe pooch baithe sab us ke qabze mein us ki mat-huti mein hain. Khalq ka Khaliq amr ka Malik wahi hai. Us ne jo kuch kiya sarasar adl hai is liye ke wahi malik hai woh zulm se pak hai. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai agar Allah Ta'ala saton aasman walon aur zameen walon ko azab kare tab bhi woh zalim nahin. Azab raham sab us ki cheezein hain. Sab ke sab Qayamat ke din us ki taraf lautaye jayenge usi ke samne hazir ho kar pesh honge. Zameen walon mein se aur aasman walon mein se koi use hara nahin sakta. Balkeh sab par wahi ghalib hai. Har ek us se kanp raha hai sab us ke dar ke faqeer hain aur sab se Ghani hai. Tumhara koi wali aur madadgar us ke siwa nahin. Allah ki aayaton se kufr karne wale us ki mulaqat ko na manne wale Allah ki rahmat se mahroom hain aur un ke liye duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnak alam-afza azab hain.

Jawab toh dalilon ka de nahin sakte thay lehaza apni quwwat se haq ko dabane lage aur apni taqat se sach ko rokne lage. Muddaton tak lakriyan jama karte rahe aur ek garha khod kar us ke gird-o-pesh ahatay ki deewaren khari karke lakriyon mein aag lagadi. Jab us ke sholay aasman tak pahunchne lage aur itni zor ki aag roshan hui ke zameen par kahin itni aag nahin dekhi gayi toh Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ko pakar kar bandh kar manjaniq mein daal kar jhalakar is aag mein daal diya. Lekin Allah ne ise apne Khalil A.S par baagh-o-bahaar banadiya. Aap kayi din ke baad sahih salamat us mein se nikal aaye. Yeh aur is jaisi qurbaniyan thin jin ke ba'is aap ko imamat ka mansab ata hua. Apna nafs aap ne Rahman ke liye, apna jism aap ne mizan ke liye, apni aulad aap ne qurban ke liye, apna maal aap ne faizan ke liye kardiya. Yehi wajah hai ke duniya ke kul adyan wale aap se mohabbat rakhte hain. Allah ne aag ko aap ke liye baagh banadiya. Is waqiye mein imandaron ke liye qudrat-e-Ilahi ki bahut si nishaniyan hain. Ek qirat mein pesh ke sath bhi hai yani tumhari yeh but parasti tumhare liye go duniya ki mohabbat hasil karade. Lekin Qayamat ke din mamla bar-aks hojayega, mawaddat ki jagah nafrat aur ittefaq ke badle ikhtilaf hojayega. Ek dusre se jhagroge, ek dusre par ilzam rakhoge, ek dusre par lanatein bhejoge. Har garoh dusre group par phatkar barsaye ga. Sab dost dushman ban jayenge, haan parhezgar nek-kar aaj bhi ek dusre ke khair-khwah aur dost rahenge. Kuffar sab ke sab maidan-e-Qayamat ki thokarain kha kha kar bil-akhir Jahannam mein jayenge. Go itna bhi na hoga ke un ki koi tarah madad karsake. Hadith mein hai tamam agle pichlon ko Allah Ta'ala ek maidan mein jama karega. Kaun jaan sakta hai ke dono simt mein kis taraf? Kehne lage ek garha khodo us mein aag bharkao aur is aag mein ise daal do ke jal jaye. Lekin Allah ne un ke is makr ko unhi par lota diya. Muddaton tak lakriyan jama karte rahe aur ek garha khod kar us ke gird-o-pesh ahatay ki deewaren khari karke lakriyon mein aag lagadi. Yeh aur is jaisi qurbaniyan thin jin ke ba'is aap ko imamat ka mansab ata hua. Hazrat Lut A.S aur Hazrat Sarah R.A. Kaha jata hai ke Hazrat Lut A.S Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke bhatije thay. Lut bin Haroon bin Aazar. Aap ki sari qoum mein se ek toh Hazrat Lut imaan laye thay aur ek Hazrat Sarah jo aap ki biwi thin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke jab aap ki biwi sahiba ko us zalim badshah ne apne sipahiyon ke zariye apne paas bulwaya toh Hazrat Ibrahim ne kaha tha ke dekho main ne apna rishta tum se bhai-behen ka banaya hai tum bhi yahi kehna kyunke us waqt duniya par mere aur tumhare siwa koi momin nahin hai, toh mumkin hai ke is se murad yeh ho ke koi miyan-biwi hamare siwa imandar nahin. Hazrat Lut aap par imaan toh laye magar usi waqt hijrat karke Sham chale gaye thay phir Ahl-e-Sadom ki taraf nabi banakar bhej diye gaye thay jaisa ke bayan guzra aur aayega. Hijrat ka irada ya toh Hazrat Lut A.S ne zahir farmaya kyunke zameer ka marja aqrab toh yahi hai. Ya Hazrat Ibrahim ne jaisa ke Ibn-e-Abbas R.A aur Zahhak R.A ka bayan hai. Toh goya Hazrat Lut A.S ke imaan lane ke baad aap ne apni qoum se dast-bardari karli aur apna irada zahir kiya ke aur kisi jagah jaon shayad wahan wale Allah wale ban jayen. Izzat Allah ki, us ke Rasool ki aur mominon ki hai. Hikmat wale aqwal, afaal, taqdeer, shariat Allah ki hai. Qatadah R.H farmate hain ke aap Kufay se hijrat karke Sham ke mulk ki taraf gaye. Hadith mein hai ke hijrat ke baad ki hijrat Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hijrat-gah ki taraf hogi. Us waqt zameen par badtareen log baqi reh jayenge jinhein zameen thook degi aur Allah un se nafrat karega, unhein aag suwaron aur bandaron ke sath hankati phiregi. Raaton ko, dinon ko unhi ke sath rahegi aur un ki jhadan khati rahegi. Aur riwayat mein hai jo un mein se peeche reh jayega use yeh aag kha jayegi aur mashriq ki taraf se kuch log meri ummat mein aise niklenge jo Quran padhenge lekin un ke gale se neeche nahin utrega, un ke khatmay ke baad dusra giroh khada hoga. Yahan tak ke aap ne bees se bhi zyada baar ise dohraya. Yahan tak ke unhi ke aakhri giroh mein se Dajjal niklega. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr R.A ka bayan hai ke ek zamana toh hum par woh tha ke hum ek musalman bhai ke liye dirham-o-dinar ko koi cheez nahin samajhte thay, apni daulat apne bhai ki hi samajhte thay, phir woh zamana aaya ke daulat hamein apne muslim bhai se zyada aziz maloom hone lagi. Main ne Huzoor ﷺ se suna hai ke agar tum bailon ki dumon ke peeche lag jaoge aur tijarat mein mashghool ho jaoge aur Allah ki raah ka jihad chhod doge toh Allah Ta'ala tumhari gardanon mein zillat ke patte daal dega jo us waqt tak tum se alag na honge jab tak ke tum phir se wahin na aa jao jahan thay aur tum tauba na kar lo. Phir wahi hadith bayan ki jo oopar guzri aur farmaya ke meri ummat mein aise log honge jo Quran padhenge aur bad-amliyan karenge, Quran un ke halqoom se neeche nahin utrega. Un ke ilm ko dekh kar tum apne ilmon ko haqeer samajhne lagoge.

Woh Ahl-e-Islam ko qatl karenge, pas jab yeh log zahir hon toh unhein qatl kar dena, phir niklein phir maar daalna, phir zahir hon phir qatl kar dena. Woh bhi khush naseeb hai jo unke hathon qatl kiya jaye aur woh bhi khush naseeb hai jo unko qatl karein. Jab unke giroh niklenge Allah unhein barbad kar dega, phir niklenge phir barbad ho jayenge, isi tarah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne koi bees martaba balkay is se bhi zyada baar yahi farmaya. Hum ne Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko Ishaq (A.S / Alaihis Salam) nami beta diya aur Ishaq (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko Yaqub (A.S / Alaihis Salam) nami. Jaise farman hai ke jab Khalilullah ne apni qoum ko aur unke maboodon ko chhor diya toh Allah ne aap ko Ishaq aur Yaqub diya aur har ek ko Nabi banaya. Is mein yeh bhi ishara hai ke pota bhi aap ki maujoodgi mein ho jayega, Ishaq (A.S / Alaihis Salam) bete thay aur Yaqub (A.S / Alaihis Salam) pote thay. Aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki biwi sahiba ko Ishaq ki aur Ishaq (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke peeche Yaqub (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki basharat di. Aur farmaya ke qoum ko chhorne ke badle Allah tumhare ghar ki basti yeh dega, jis se tumhari aankhein thandi rahein. Pas sabit hua ke Hazrat Yaqub (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Hazrat Ishaq (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke farzand thay. Yahi sunnat se bhi sabit hai, Quran ki aur aayat mein hai ke tum us waqt maujood thay jab Hazrat Yaqub (A.S / Alaihis Salam) maut ka waqt aaya toh woh apne larkon se kehne lage tum mere baad kis ki ibadat karoge? Unhon ne kaha aap ki aur aap ke walid Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam), Ismail (A.S / Alaihis Salam), Ishaq (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke walid ki jo yakta hai aur wahid la-shareek hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Kareem bin Kareem bin Kareem Yusuf bin Yaqub (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Ishaq (A.S / Alaihis Salam) bin Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) hain. Alaihimus Salatu Wassalam. Ibn Abbas (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) se jo marwi hai ke Ishaq-o-Yaqub Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke farzand thay, is se murad farzand ke farzand ko farzand keh dena hai. Yeh nahin ke sulbi farzand dono thay, Ibn Abbas (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) toh kaha hai ke adna aadmi bhi aisi thokar nahin kha sakta. Hum ne inhi ki aulad mein Kitab-o-Nabuwwat rakh di. Khalil ka khitab inhi ko mila, inhein kaha gaya phir unke baad inhi ki nasl mein nabuwwat-o-hikmat rahi. Bani Israel ke tamam ambiya Hazrat Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki nasl se hain. Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) tak toh yeh silsila yunhi chala. Bani Israel ke is aakhri paighambar ne apni ummat ko saaf keh diya ke main ne tumhein Nabi-e-Arabi, Quraishi, Hashimi, Khatam-ur-Rusul, Sayyid-e-Aulad-e-Adam ki basharat deta hoon. Jinhein Allah ne chun liya hai, aap Hazrat Ismail (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki nasl mein se thay. Hazrat Ismail (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki aulad mein se aap ke siwaye aur Nabi nahin hua. Alaihi Afdalus Salatu Wattasleem. Hum ne inhein duniya ke sawab bhi diye aur aakhirat ki nekiyan bhi ata farmayin. Duniya mein rizq-e-wasee, jagah paak, biwi nek, seerat-e-jameel aur zikr-e-hassan diya, sari duniya ke dilon mein aap ki mohabbat daal di. Bawajood-e-ke apni itaat ki taufiq roz-ba-roz aur zyada di. Kamil itaat guzari ki taufiq ke sath duniya ki bhaliyan bhi ata farmayin. Aur aakhirat mein bhi saliheen mein rakha. Jaise farman hai Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) mukammal farman-bardar thay, muwahhid thay, mushrikon mein se na thay, aakhirat mein bhale logon ka sathi hua.

Kufr, takzeeb-e-Rasool, Allah ke hukm ki mukhalifat toh khair aur bhi karte rahe magar mardon se haajat rawaai toh kisi ne bhi nahin ki. Doosri bad khislat un mein yeh bhi thi ke raaste rokte the, daake daalte the, qatl-o-fasaad karte the, maal loot lete the, majlison mein al-al-ailan buri baatein aur laghw harkatein karte the. Koi kisi ko nahin rokta tha yahan tak ke baaz ka qaul hai ke woh liwat bhi al-al-ailan karte the, goya society ka ek mashghala yeh bhi tha, hawayein nikaal kar hanste the, mendhe ladwate aur badtareen buraiyan karte the aur al-al-ailan maze le le kar gunah karte the. Hum bhi teri sachai dekhein. Aajiz aa kar Hazrat Loot (A.S) ne bhi Allah ke aage haath phaila diye ke Aye Allah! In mufsidon par mujhe ghalba de, meri madad kar.

Isi ke zamanay mein Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah (A.S) nabi ho kar us ki taraf bhejay gaye. Yeh dono Qibti kafir thay jab in ki sarkashi had se guzar gayi, Allah ki tauheed ke munkir ho gaye, rasoolon ko eezaein dein aur in ki na maani to Allah Ta'ala ne in sab ko tarah tarah ke azabon se halak kiya. 'Aadiyon par hawayein bhejein. Inhein apni quwwat-o-taqat ka bada ghamand tha, kisi ko apne muqablay ka na jaantay thay. In par hawa bheji jo badi tez-o-tund thi jo in par zameen ke patthar uda uda kar barsanay lagi. Bil-aakhir zor pakartay pakartay yahan tak badh gayi ke inhein uchak le jaati aur aasman ke qareeb le ja kar phir gira deti. Sar ke bal girtay aur sar alag ho jata, dhad alag ho jata aur aisay ho jatay jaise khajoor ke darakht jis ke tanay alag hon aur shakhain juda hon. Thamudiyon par hujjat-e-Ilahi poori hui, dalail de diye gaye, in ki talab ke muwafiq patthar mein se in ke dekhtay huay oontni nikli lekin taham inhein imaan naseeb na hua balkay tughyani mein badhtay rahay. Allah ke nabi ko dhamkanay aur daranay lagay aur imandaron se bhi kehnay lagay ke hamaray shehar chhod do warna hum tumhein sangsar kar denge. Inhein ek cheekh se para para kar diya. Dil hil gaye, kalejay ud gaye aur sab ki roohein nikal gayin. Qaroon ne sarkashi aur takabbur kiya. Tughyani aur badai ki, Rabb-ul-A'ala ki nafarmani ki, zameen mein fasad macha diya. Akar akar kar chalnay laga, apne dantar-bal dekhnay laga, utranay laga aur phoolnay laga. Pas Allah ne usay ma'a us ke mehalat ke zameen-doz kar diya jo aaj tak dhans-ta chala ja raha hai. Firaun, Haman aur in ke lashkaron ko subh hi subh ek sath ek hi sa'at mein darya-burd kar diya. In mein se ek bhi na bacha jo in ka naam to kabhi leta. Allah ne yeh jo kuch kiya kuch in par zulm na tha balkay in ke zulm ka badla tha. In ke kartoot ka phal tha, in ki karni ki bharni thi. Yeh bayan yahan bator-e-laf-o-nashr ke hai. Awalan jhutlanay wali ummaton ka zikr hua hai phir in mein se har ek ko azabon se halak karnay ka. Kisi ne kaha ke sab se pehlay jin par pattharon ka meenh barsanay ka zikr hai in se murad Louti hain aur gharq ki janay wali qoum qoum-e-Nuh hai lekin yeh qaul theek nahin. Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh marwi to hai lekin sanad mein inqita' hai. In dono qoumon ki halat ka zikr isi surat mein ba-tafseel bayan ho chuka hai. Phir bohat se faaslay ke baad yeh bayan hua hai.

Allah ne yeh jo kuch kiya kuch in par zulm na tha balkay in ke zulm ka badla tha. In ke kartoot ka phal tha, in ki karni ki bharni thi. Yeh bayan yahan bator-e-laf-o-nashr ke hai. Awalan jhutlanay wali ummaton ka zikr hua hai phir in mein se har ek ko azabon se halak karnay ka. Kisi ne kaha ke sab se pehlay jin par pattharon ka meenh barsanay ka zikr hai in se murad Louti hain aur gharq ki janay wali qoum qoum-e-Nuh hai lekin yeh qaul theek nahin. Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh marwi to hai lekin sanad mein inqita' hai. In dono qoumon ki halat ka zikr isi surat mein ba-tafseel bayan ho chuka hai. Phir bohat se faaslay ke baad yeh bayan hua hai.

Qatadah se yeh bhi marwi hai ke pattharon ka meena jin par barsaya gaya un se murad Loti hain aur jinhein cheekh se halak kiya gaya un se murad Qaum-e-Shuaib hai lekin yeh qaul bhi in aayaton se door daraz hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ahqaf ke log 'Aadi Hazrat Hud (A.S) ki qoum thay. Ahqaf mein rehte thay jo Yaman ke shehron mein Hadhramaut ke qareeb hai. Thamudi Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki qoum ke log thay. Yeh Hijr mein bastay thay jo Wadi-ul-Qura ke qareeb hai. Arab ke raastay mein in ki basti aati thi jisay yeh bakhoobi jaantay thay. Qaroon ek daulat-mand shakhs tha jis ke bharpoor khazanon ki kunjiyan ek jamaat ki jamaat uthati thi. Firaun Misr ka badshah tha aur Haman uska wazeer-e-azam tha. Isi ke zamanay mein Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah (A.S) nabi ho kar us ki taraf bhejay gaye. Yeh dono Qibti kafir thay jab in ki sarkashi had se guzar gayi, Allah ki tauheed ke munkir ho gaye, rasoolon ko eezaein dein aur in ki na maani to Allah Ta'ala ne in sab ko tarah tarah ke azabon se halak kiya. 'Aadiyon par hawayein bhejein. Inhein apni quwwat-o-taqat ka bada ghamand tha, kisi ko apne muqablay ka na jaantay thay. In par hawa bheji jo badi tez-o-tund thi jo in par zameen ke patthar uda uda kar barsanay lagi. Bil-aakhir zor pakartay pakartay yahan tak badh gayi ke inhein uchak le jaati aur aasman ke qareeb le ja kar phir gira deti. Sar ke bal girtay aur sar alag ho jata, dhad alag ho jata aur aisay ho jatay jaise khajoor ke darakht jis ke tanay alag hon aur shakhain juda hon. Thamudiyon par hujjat-e-Ilahi poori hui, dalail de diye gaye, in ki talab ke muwafiq patthar mein se in ke dekhtay huay oontni nikli lekin taham inhein imaan naseeb na hua balkay tughyani mein badhtay rahay. Allah ke nabi ko dhamkanay aur daranay lagay aur imandaron se bhi kehnay lagay ke hamaray shehar chhod do warna hum tumhein sangsar kar denge. Inhein ek cheekh se para para kar diya. Dil hil gaye, kalejay ud gaye aur sab ki roohein nikal gayin. Qaroon ne sarkashi aur takabbur kiya. Tughyani aur badai ki, Rabb-ul-A'ala ki nafarmani ki, zameen mein fasad macha diya. Makri ka jala. Jo log Allah Ta'ala ke siwa auron ki parastish aur pooja-paat karte hain un ki kamzori aur be-ilmi ka bayan ho raha hai. Yeh un se madad, rozi aur sakhti mein kaam aane ke umeedwar rehte hain. Un ki misaal aisi hai jaise koi makri ke jaale mein barish aur dhoop aur sardi se panah chahe. Agar in mein ilm hota toh yeh Khaliq ko chhor kar makhlooq se umeedein wabasta na karte. Pas un ka haal imandaron ke haal ke bilkul bar-aks hai. Woh ek mazboot kare ko thame hue hain aur yeh makri ke jaale mein apna sar chupaye hue hain. Us ka dil Allah ki taraf hai, us ka jism aamal-e-saliha ki taraf mashghool hai aur is ka dil makhlooq ki taraf aur jism us ki parastish ki taraf jhuka hua hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ko dara raha hai ke woh un se, un ke shirk se aur un ke jhoote maboodon se khoob aagah hai. Unhein un ki shararat ka aisa maza chakhaye ga ke yeh yaad karein. Unhein dheel dene mein bhi us ki maslahat-o-hikmat hai. Na yeh ke woh Aleem Allah un se be-khabar ho. Hum ne toh misalon se bhi masail samjha diye. Lekin is ke sochne samajhne ka madda in mein gaur-o-fikr karne ki taufeeq sirf ba-amal ulama ko hoti hai, jo apne ilm mein poore hain. Is aayat se sabit hua ke Allah ki bayan karda misalon ko samajh lena sachay ilm ki daleel hai. Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) farmate hain main ne ek hazaar misalein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se seekhi hain (Musnad Ahmad). Is se aap ki fazeelat aur aap ki ilmiyat zahir hai. Hazrat Amr bin Marwah farmate hain ke Kalam-e-Allah Sharif ki jo aayat meri tilawat mein aaye aur us ka tafseeli ma'non ka matlab meri samajh mein na aaye toh mera dil dukhta hai, mujhe sakht takleef hoti hai aur main darne lagta hoon ke kahin Allah ke nazdeek meri ginti jahilon mein toh nahin ho gayi, kyunke farman-e-Allah yahi hai ke hum in misalon ko logon ke samne pesh kar rahe hain lekin siwaye aalimon ke inhein dusre samajh nahin sakte.

Maqsad-e-Kainat: Allah Ta'ala ki bahut badi qudrat ka bayan ho raha hai ke wahi aasmanon ka aur zameenon ka khaliq hai. Usne inhe khel tamashe ke taur par ya laghw-o-bekaar nahin banaya, balki isliye ke yahan logon ko basaye. Phir unki nekiyan badiyan dekhe. Aur Qayamat ke din unke aamal ke mutabiq unhein jaza-o-saza de. Buron ko unki bad-aamaliyon par saza aur nekon ko unki nekiyon par behtareen badla.

Ikhlas, khauf aur Allah ka zikr. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aur imandaron ko hukum de raha hai ke woh Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat karte rahein aur ise auron ko bhi sunayein aur namazon ki nigahbani karein aur pabandi se padhte raha karein. Namaz insaan ko nashaista kamon aur nalaiq harkaton se baaz rakhti hai. Nabi-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke jis namazi ki namaz ne use gunahon se aur siyah kariyon se baaz na rakha woh Allah se bahut door ho jata hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is aayat ki tafseer daryaft ki gayi toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jise uski namaz beja aur fahash kamon se na roke toh samajh lo ke uski namaz Allah ke haan maqbool nahin hui. Aur riwayat mein hai ke woh Allah se door hi hota chala jayega. Ek mauqoof riwayat mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jo namazi bhale kamon mein mashghool aur bure kamon se bachne wala na ho samajh lo ke uski namaz use Allah se aur door karti ja rahi hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo namaz ki baat na maane uski namaz nahin, namaz behayai se aur bad-filiyon se rokti hai iski ita'at yeh hai ke in behooda kamon se namazi ruk jaye. Hazrat Shoaib (A.S) se jab unki qoum ne kaha ke Shoaib kya tumhein tumhari namaz hukum karti hai toh Hazrat Sufyan (R.H) ne iski tafseer mein farmaya ke haan Allah ki qasam namaz hukum bhi karti hai aur mana bhi karti hai. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se kisi ne kaha falan shakhs badi lambi namaz padhta hai aap (R.A) ne farmaya namaz use nafa deti hai jo uska kaha maane. Meri tehqeeq mein oopar jo marfoo riwayat bayan hui hai uska bhi mauqoof hona hi zyada sahih hai. Wallahu A'lam. Bazzar mein hai ke Huzoor-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kisi ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) falan shakhs namaz padhta hai lekin chori nahin chhodta toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya anqareeb uski namaz uski yeh burai chhudade gi. Chunki namaz zikr-e-Allah ka naam hai isi liye iske baad hi farmaya Allah ki yaad badi cheez hai Allah Ta'ala tumhari tamam baton se aur tumhare kul kamon se bakhabar hai. Hazrat Abul Aliyah (R.H) farmate hain namaz teen cheezein hain agar yeh na hon toh namaz namaz nahin: Ikhlas-o-Khuloos, Khauf-e-Allah aur Zikr-e-Allah. Ikhlas se toh insaan nek ho jata hai aur khauf-e-Allah se insaan gunahon ko chhod deta hai aur zikr-e-Allah yani Quran use bhalai-o-burai bata deta hai woh hukum bhi karta hai aur mana bhi karta hai. Ibn-e-Aun Ansari (R.H) farmate hain jab tu namaz mein ho toh neki mein hai aur namaz tujhe fahash aur munkar se bachaye hue hai. Aur is mein jo kuch tu zikr-e-Allah kar raha hai woh tere liye bade hi faide ki cheez hai. Hammad (R.H) ka qaul hai ke kam se kam halat-e-namaz mein toh buraiyon se bacha rahega. Ek rawi se Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka yeh qaul marwi hai ke jo banda yaad-e-Allah karta hai Allah Ta'ala bhi use yaad karta hai. Usne kaha hamare haan jo sahib hain woh toh kehte hain ke matlab iska yeh hai ke jab tum Allah ka zikr karoge toh woh tumhari yaad karega aur yeh bahut badi cheez hai.

Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ayat (FAZKURUNI AZKURKUM WASHKURU LI WALA TAKFURUN) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 152) keh tum meri yaad karo main tumhari yaad karunga. Isay sun kar Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya usne sach kaha yani dono matlab durust hain. Yeh bhi aur woh bhi aur khud Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se yeh bhi tafsir marvi hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Rabia se ek martaba Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ne daryaft farmaya keh is jumlay ka matlab jantay ho? Unhon ne kaha haan is se murad namaz mein SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar waghera kehna hai. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya tu ne ajeeb baat kahi yeh yun nahin hai balkeh maqsood yeh hai keh hukm ke aur mana ke waqt Allah ka tumhein yaad karna tumhare zikr-e-Allah se bahut bada aur bahut ahem hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A), Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A), Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) waghera se bhi yahi marvi hai. Aur isi ko Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) pasand farmatay hain.

Ghair muslimon ko dalail se qail karo. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) waghera toh farmate hain ke yeh aayat toh jihad ke hukm ke sath mansookh hai, ab toh yahi hai ke ya toh Islam qabool karo ya jizya ada karo ya ladai ladein. Lekin aur buzurg mufassireen ka qaul hai ke yeh hukm baqi hai, jo yahudi ya nasrani deeni umoor ko samajhna chahe aur use muhazzab tareeqe par suljhe hue pairaye se samjha dena chahiye. Kya ajab hai ke woh rah-e-rast ikhtiyar kare. Jaise aur aayat mein aam hukm majood hai aayat (UD'U ILA SABILI RABBIKA BIL-HIKMATI WAL-MAW'IZATIL-HASANATI WA JADILHUM BILLATI HIYA AHSANU, INNA RABBAKA HUWA A'LAMU BIMAN DALLA 'AN SABILIHI WA HUWA A'LAMU BIL-MUHTADEEN) (16. An-Nahl: 125) apne Rab ki rah ki dawat hikmat aur behtareen nasihat ke sath logon ko do. Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ko jab Firaun ki taraf bheja jata hai toh farman hota hai ke aayat (FAQULA LAHU QAWLAN LAYYINAN LA'ALLAHU YATAZAKKARU AW YAKHSHA) (20. Taha: 44) yani us se narmi se guftagu karna, kya ajab ke woh nasihat qabool kar le aur us ka dil pighal jaye. Yehi qaul Hazrat Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ka pasandeeda hai aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) se yehi marwi hai. Haan, in mein se jo zulm par ad jayein aur zid aur ta'assub bartein, haq ko qabool karne se inkar kar dein, phir munazire aur mubahise besood hain, phir toh jidal-o-qital ka hukm hai. Jaise Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu ka irshad hai aayat (LAQAD ARSALNA RUSULANA BIL-BAYYINATI WA ANZALNA MA'AHUMUL-KITABA WAL-MIZANA LIYAQUMAN-NASU BIL-QIST) (57. Al-Hadid: 25) hum ne rasoolon ko wazeh daleelon ke sath bheja aur un ke hamrah kitab-o-mizan nazil farmayi taake logon mein adl-o-insaf ka qayam ho sake. Aur hum ne loha bhi nazil farmaya jis mein sakht ladai hai. Pas hukm-e-Allah yeh hai ke bhalai se aur narmi se jo na maane us par phir sakhti ki jaye. Jo lade usi se lada jaye, haan yeh aur baat hai ke mat-huti mein reh kar jizya ada kare. Phir tasdeeq kar diya karo, mumkin hai kisi amr-e-haq ko tum jhutla do aur mumkin hai kisi batil ki tum tasdeeq kar baitho. Pas shart yeh hai ke tasdeeq karo yani keh do ke hamara Allah ki har baat par imaan hai, agar tumhari pesh karda cheez Allah ki nazil karda hai toh hum use tasleem karte hain aur agar tum ne tabdeel-o-tahreef kar di hai toh hum use nahin maante. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab Torah ko Ibrani zaban mein padhte aur hamare samne Arabi mein us ka tarjuma karte, is par Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne farmaya na tum unhein sacha kaho na jhoota, balkeh tum aayat (Aamanna billazi) se aakhir aayat tak padh diya karo. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas ek yahudi aaya aur kehne laga kya yeh janaze bolte hain? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah hi ko ilm hai.

Us ne kaha main jaanta hoon yeh yaqeenan bolte hain. Is par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh Ahl-e-Kitab jab tum se koi baat bayan karein toh tum na un ki tasdeeq karo na takzeeb, balkeh keh do hamara Allah par aur us ki kitabon par aur us ke Rasoolon par imaan hai. Yeh is liye keh kahin aisa na ho tum kisi jhoot ko sacha keh do ya kisi sach ko jhoot bata do. Yahan yeh bhi khayal rahe keh in Ahl-e-Kitab ki aksar-o-beshtar baatein toh ghalat aur jhoot hi hoti hain, umooman bohtan-o-iftira hota hai. In mein tehreef-o-tabaddul, taghayyur-o-taweel riwaj pa chuki hai aur sadaqat aisi reh gayi hai keh goya kuch bhi nahin. Phir ek baat aur bhi hai keh bilfarz sach bhi ho toh hamein kya faida? Hamare paas toh Allah ki taaza aur kamil kitab majood hai. Chunancha Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain Ahl-e-Kitab se tum kuch bhi na poocho. Woh khud jabkeh gumrah hain toh tumhari tas-heeh kya karenge? Haan yeh ho sakta hai keh un ki kisi sach baat ko tum jhoota keh do, ya un ki kisi jhooti baat ko tum sach keh do. Yaad rakho har Ahl-e-Kitab ke dil mein apne deen ka ek ta'assub hai, jaise keh maal ki khwahish hai (Ibn-e-Jareer). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain tum Ahl-e-Kitab se sawalat kyun karte ho? Tum par toh Allah ki taraf se abhi abhi kitab nazil hui hai jo bilkul khalis hai jis mein batil na mila na mil-jul sake. Tum se toh khud Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai keh Ahl-e-Kitab ne Allah ke deen ko badal dala. Allah ki kitab mein taghayyur kar diya aur apne hathon ki likhi hui kitabon ko Allah ki kitab kehne lage aur dunyawi nafa hasil karne lage. Kyun bhala tumhare paas jo ilm-e-Allah hai kya woh tumhein kafi nahin? Keh tum un se daryaft karo. Dekho toh kis qadar sitam hai keh un mein se toh ek bhi tum se kabhi kuch na pooche aur tum un se daryaft karte phiro? Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai keh ek martaba Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah (R.A) ne Madine mein Quraish ki ek jamaat ke samne farmaya keh dekho in tamam Ahl-e-Kitab mein aur un ki baatein bayan karne walon mein sab se achay Hazrat Ka'ab bin Ahbar (R.A) hain lekin bawajood is ke bhi un ki baton mein bhi hum kabhi kabhi jhoot paate hain. Un mein mazboot zi-ilm hafizon ki jamaat thi hi nahin. Phir farmata hai ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum in mein muddat-ul-umr tak reh chukay ho, is Quran ke nazil honay se pehlay apni umr ka ek bada hissa in mein guzar chukay ho, inhein khoob maloom hai ke aap padhay likhay nahin, sari qoum aur sara mulk bakhoobi ilm rakhta hai ke aap mehez Ummi hain, na likhna jantay hain na padhna. Phir aaj jo aap ko anokhi faseeh-o-baleeg aur pur-az-hikmat kitab padhtay hain zahir hai ke woh Allah ki taraf se hai. Aap is halat mein ek harf padhay huay nahin, khud tasneef-o-taleef kar nahin saktay. Lutf yeh hai ke Allah ke ma'soom Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamesha likhnay se door hi rakhay gaye. Ek satr ke ma'ni, ek harf bhi likhna aap ko na aata tha. Aap ne katib muqarrar kar liye thay jo Wahi-e-Ilahi ko likh letay thay aur zaroorat ke waqt shahan-e-dunya se khat-o-kitabat bhi wahi kartay thay. Pichlay fuqaha mein Qazi Abu-ul-Waleed Baji waghera ne kaha ke Hudaibiya walay din khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apnay hath se yeh jumla sulh-namay mein likha tha ke "Haza ma qada 'alaihi Muhammad-un-ibnu Abdullah" yani yeh woh sharait hain jin par Muhammad bin Abdullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne faisla kiya. Lekin yeh qaul durust nahin, yeh weham Qazi sahab ko Bukhari Sharif ki is riwayat se hua hai jis mein yeh alfaaz hain ke "Summa akhaza faktaba" yani phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aap le kar likha. Lekin is ka matlab yeh hai ke aap ne likhnay ka hukm diya. Jaise doosri riwayat mein saaf majood hai ke "Summa amara fakutiba" yani aap ne phir hukm diya aur likha gaya. Mashriq-o-Maghrib ke tamam ulama ka yahi mazhab hai, balkay Baji waghera par unhon ne is qaul ka bohat sakht radd kiya hai aur is se bezari zahir ki hai. Aur is qaul ki tardeed apnay ash'aar aur khutbon mein bhi ki hai. Lekin yeh bhi khayal rahay ke Qazi sahab waghera ka yeh khayal hargiz nahin ke aap achi tarah likhna jantay thay balkay woh yeh kehtay thay ke aap ka yeh jumla sulh-namay par likha jana mo'jiza tha.

Jaisa ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke Dajjal ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan 'Kafir' likha hua hoga aur ek riwayat mein hai ke 'K-F-R' likha hua hoga jise har momin parh lega agarcheh an-parh ho tab bhi use parh lega. Yeh momin ki ek karamat hogi. Isi tarah yeh fiqra likh lena Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek mojza tha, iska matlab hargiz yeh nahin ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) likhna jante the ya Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne seekha tha. Baaz log ek riwayat pesh karte hain jismein hai ke Aan-Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka inteqal na hua jab tak ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne likhna na seekh liya. Yeh riwayat bilkul zaeef hai, balkeh mehez be-asl hai. Quran-e-Kareem ki is aayat ko dekhiye kis qadar takeed ke sath Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke parha (unlettered) hone ka inkar karti hai aur kitni sakhti ke sath pur-zor alfaaz mein iska bhi inkar karti hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) likhna jante hon. Yeh jo farmaya ke 'dahne hath se' yeh ba-aitbar-e-ghalib ke keh diya hai, warna likha to daen hath se hi jata hai. Ta'ajjub hai ke bawajood aisa na hone ke phir bhi yeh log hamare Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par yeh ilzam lagate hain aur kehte hain ke yeh guzre hue logon ki kahaniyan hain jinhein isne likh liya hai. Yahan farmaya balkeh yeh roshan aayatein hain jo ahl-e-ilm ke seenon mein hain. Khud aayatein wazeh, saaf aur suljhe hue alfaaz mein hain. To ise sote jagte parhta rahega.' Matlab yeh hai ke iske huroof pani se dhoye jayen lekin woh zaya hone se mehfooz hai. Jaise ke hadith mein hai agar Quran kisi chamre mein ho to ise aag nahin jalayegi.

Yehi wajah hai ke sabqa kitabon mein is ummat ki ek sifat yeh bhi marwi hai ke "Anaajeeluhum fee sudoorihim" (un ki kitabein un ke seenon mein hongi). Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) isay pasand farmate hain ke ma'ani yeh hain, balkay is ka ilm ke tu is kitab se pehle koi kitab nahin parhta tha aur na apne haath se kuch likhta tha, yeh Aayat-e-Bayyinat Ahl-e-Kitab ke zi-ilm logon ke seenon mein majood hain. Qatadah (R.H) aur Ibn-e-Jureij (R.H) se bhi yehi manqool hai aur pehla qaul Hasan Basri (R.H) ka hai aur yehi ba-riwayat-e-Aufi, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool hai aur yeh Zahhak (R.H) ne kaha hai aur yehi zyada zahir hai, Wallahu A'alam. Phir farmata hai ke hamari aayaton ka jhutlana, qabool na karna yeh had se guzar jaane walon aur ziddi logon ka hi kaam hai jo haq-o-nahaq ko samajhte hain aur na us ki taraf mail hote hain, jaise farman hai: "Jin par tere Rab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh hargiz imaan na layenge, agarche un ke paas nishaniyan aa jayen. Yahan tak ke woh almanaak azaab ka mushahida kar lein."

Lekin yeh qaul durust nahin, yeh weham Qazi sahab ko Bukhari Sharif ki is riwayat se hua hai jis mein yeh alfaaz hain ke "Summa akhaza faktaba" yani phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aap le kar likha. Lekin is ka matlab yeh hai ke aap ne likhnay ka hukm diya. Jaise doosri riwayat mein saaf majood hai ke "Summa amara fakutiba" yani aap ne phir hukm diya aur likha gaya. Mashriq-o-Maghrib ke tamam ulama ka yahi mazhab hai, balkay Baji waghera par unhon ne is qaul ka bohat sakht radd kiya hai aur is se bezari zahir ki hai. Aur is qaul ki tardeed apnay ash'aar aur khutbon mein bhi ki hai. Lekin yeh bhi khayal rahay ke Qazi sahab waghera ka yeh khayal hargiz nahin ke aap achi tarah likhna jantay thay balkay woh yeh kehtay thay ke aap ka yeh jumla sulh-namay par likha jana mo'jiza tha.

Jaisa ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke Dajjal ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan 'Kafir' likha hua hoga aur ek riwayat mein hai ke 'K-F-R' likha hua hoga jise har momin parh lega agarcheh an-parh ho tab bhi use parh lega. Yeh momin ki ek karamat hogi. Isi tarah yeh fiqra likh lena Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka ek mojza tha, iska matlab hargiz yeh nahin ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) likhna jante the ya Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne seekha tha. Baaz log ek riwayat pesh karte hain jismein hai ke Aan-Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka inteqal na hua jab tak ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne likhna na seekh liya. Yeh riwayat bilkul zaeef hai, balkeh mehez be-asl hai. Quran-e-Kareem ki is aayat ko dekhiye kis qadar takeed ke sath Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke parha (unlettered) hone ka inkar karti hai aur kitni sakhti ke sath pur-zor alfaaz mein iska bhi inkar karti hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) likhna jante hon. Yeh jo farmaya ke 'dahne hath se' yeh ba-aitbar-e-ghalib ke keh diya hai, warna likha to daen hath se hi jata hai. Isi ki tarah aayat (وَلَا طٰۗىِٕرٍ يَّطِيْرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ اِلَّآ اُمَمٌ اَمْثَالُكُمْ) (Surah Al-An'am: 38) mein hai, kyunke har parinda apne paron se hi urta hai. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka un-parh hona bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke agar Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) parhe likhe hote to yeh batil parast aap ki nisbat shak karne ki gunjaish pate ke sabqa ambiya ki kitabon se parh likh kar naqal kar leta hai, lekin yahan to aisa nahin. Ta'ajjub hai ke bawajood aisa na hone ke phir bhi yeh log hamare Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par yeh ilzam lagate hain aur kehte hain ke yeh guzre hue logon ki kahaniyan hain jinhein isne likh liya hai. Wohi iske samne subh-o-sham parhi jati hain. Bawajood-e-ke khud jante hain ke hamare Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) parhe likhe nahin. Unke is qaul ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu ne farmaya unhein jawab do ke ise us Allah ne nazil farmaya hai jo zameen-o-aasman ki poshidgiyon ko janta hai. Yahan farmaya balkeh yeh roshan aayatein hain jo ahl-e-ilm ke seenon mein hain. Khud aayatein wazeh, saaf aur suljhe hue alfaaz mein hain. Phir ulama par inka samajhna, yaad karna, pahunchana sab aasan hai, jaise farman hai aayat (وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ للذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ) (Surah Al-Qamar: 17) yani humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye bilkul aasan kar diya hai, pas kya koi hai jo is se nasihat hasil kare. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har nabi ko aisi cheez di gayi jiske baais log un par iman laye, mujhe aisi cheez 'Wahi-e-Ilahi' di gayi hai jo Allah ne meri taraf nazil farmayi hai, to mujhe Zaat-e-Allah se umeed hai ke tamam nabiyon ke tabedaron se zyada mere tabedar honge. Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke 'Ae Nabi! Main tumhein aazmaunga aur tumhari wajah se logon ki bhi aazmaish kar lunga. Main tum par aisi kitab nazil farmaunga jise pani dho na sake. To ise sote jagte parhta rahega.' Matlab yeh hai ke iske huroof pani se dhoye jayen lekin woh zaya hone se mehfooz hai. Jaise ke hadith mein hai agar Quran kisi chamre mein ho to ise aag nahin jalayegi.

Is liye ke woh seenon mein mehfooz hai, zabanon par aasaan hai aur dilon mein majood hai. Aur apne lafz aur ma'ani ke aitbaar se ek jeeta jaagta mojiza hai. Yehi wajah hai ke sabqa kitabon mein is ummat ki ek sifat yeh bhi marwi hai ke "Anaajeeluhum fee sudoorihim" (un ki kitabein un ke seenon mein hongi). Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) isay pasand farmate hain ke ma'ani yeh hain, balkay is ka ilm ke tu is kitab se pehle koi kitab nahin parhta tha aur na apne haath se kuch likhta tha, yeh Aayat-e-Bayyinat Ahl-e-Kitab ke zi-ilm logon ke seenon mein majood hain. Qatadah (R.H) aur Ibn-e-Jureij (R.H) se bhi yehi manqool hai aur pehla qaul Hasan Basri (R.H) ka hai aur yehi ba-riwayat-e-Aufi, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool hai aur yeh Zahhak (R.H) ne kaha hai aur yehi zyada zahir hai, Wallahu A'alam. Phir farmata hai ke hamari aayaton ka jhutlana, qabool na karna yeh had se guzar jaane walon aur ziddi logon ka hi kaam hai jo haq-o-nahaq ko samajhte hain aur na us ki taraf mail hote hain, jaise farman hai: "Jin par tere Rab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh hargiz imaan na layenge, agarche un ke paas nishaniyan aa jayen. Yahan tak ke woh almanaak azaab ka mushahida kar lein."

Mahasin-e-Kalam ka bemisal jamal. Quran-e-Hakim kafiron ki zid, takabbur aur hat-dharmi bayan ho rahi hai ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aisi hi nishani talab ki jaisi ke Hazrat Saleh (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se unki qoum ne mangi thi. Phir apne Nabi ko hukum deta hai unhein jawab dijiye ke aayatein, mojze aur nishanat dikhana mere bas ki baat nahin. Yeh Allah ke haath hai. Agar usne tumhari nek niyatein maloom kar lein toh woh mojza dikhayega aur agar tum apni zid aur inkar se barh barh kar baatein hi bana rahe ho toh woh Allah tum se daba hua nahin ke uski chahat tumhari chahat ke tabe ho jaye, tum jo mango woh kar hi dikhaye ga. Jaise ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aayatein bhejne se hamein koi mani nahin siwaye iske ke guzashta log bhi barabar inkar hi karte rahe. Qoum-e-Samood ko dekho hamari nishani oontni jo unke paas aayi unhon ne us par zulm kiya. Keh do ke main toh sirf ek muballigh hoon, paighambar hoon, qasid hoon, mera kaam tumhare kaanon tak aawaz-e-Allah ko pahuncha dena hai, maine toh tumhein tumhara bura bhala samjha diya, nek bad samjha diya, ab tum jano tumhara kaam jane. Hidayat-o-zalalat Allah ki taraf se hai, woh agar kisi ko gumrah kar de toh uski rahbar-e-koi nahin kar sakta. Chunancha ek aur jagah hai tujh par unki hidayat ka zimma nahin, yeh Allah ka kaam hai aur uski chahat par mauqoof hai. Bhala is fazool goi ko toh dekho ke Kitab-e-Aziz unke paas aa chuki jis ke paas kisi taraf se batil phatak nahin sakta aur unhein ab tak nishani ki talab hai. Halankeh yeh toh tamam mojzaat se barh kar mojza hai. Tamam duniya ke faseeh-o-baleeh is ke muariza se aur is jaisa kalam pesh karne se aajiz aa gaye. Poore Quran ka toh muariza kya karte? Das suraton ka balkeh ek surat ka muariza bhi challenge ke bawajood na kar sake. Toh kya itna bara aur itna bhari mojza unhein kafi nahin? Jo aur mojze talab karne baithe hain. Yeh toh woh pak kitab hai jis mein guzashta baaton ki khabar hai aur hone wali baaton ki peshgoi hai aur jhagron ka faisla hai aur yeh uski zaban se parhi jati hai jo mehez ummi hai jis ne kisi se alif-ba bhi nahin parha, jo ek harf likhna nahin janta balkeh ahl-e-ilm ki sohbat mein bhi kabhi nahin baitha. Aur woh kitab parhta hai jis se guzashta kitabon ki bhi sehat-o-adam-e-sehat maloom hoti hai, jis ke alfaaz mein halawat, jis ki nazm mein malahut, jis ke andaaz mein fasahat, jis ke bayan mein balaghat, jis ka tarz-e-dilruba, jis ka siyaq dilchasp, jis mein duniya bhar ki khoobiyan mojood. Khud Bani Israel ke ulama bhi is ki tasdeeq par majboor. Agli kitabein jis par shahid. Bhale log jis ke maddah aur qail-o-aamil. Is itne bare mojze ki maujoodgi mein kisi aur mojza ki talab mehez badniyati aur gurez hai. Phir farmata hai is mein iman walon ke liye rahmat-o-nasihat hai. Yeh Quran haq ka zahir karne wala, batil ko barbad karne wala hai. Guzashta logon ke waqiyat tumhare samne rakh kar tumhein nasihat-o-ibrat ka mauqa deta hai, gunahgaron ka anjam dikha kar tumhein gunahon se rokta hai.

Keh do ke mere aur tumhare darmiyan Allah gawah hai aur uski gawahi kaafi hai. Woh tumhari takzeeb-o-sarkashi ko aur meri sachai-o-khair khwahi ko bakhoobi jaanta hai. Agar main us par jhoot baandhta toh woh zaroor mujh se inteqam leta, woh aise logon ko baghair inteqam nahin chhodta. Jaise khud uska farman hai ke agar yeh Rasool (ﷺ) mujh par ek baat bhi ghad leta toh main uska dahina haath pakad kar uski rag-e-jaan kaat deta aur koi na hota jo use mere haath se chhudasake. Chunki us par meri sachai roshan hai aur main usi ka bheja hua hoon aur uska naam le kar uski kahi hui tum se kehta hoon is liye woh meri ta'eed karta hai aur mujhe roz-ba-roz ghalba deta jaata hai aur mujh se mojizaat par mojizaat zahir karata hai. Woh zameen-o-aasman ke ghaib ka jaanne wala hai, us par ek zarra bhi posheeda nahin. Baatil ka maanne wale aur Allah ko na maanne wale hi nuqsan yafta aur zaleel hain. Qayamat ke din unhein unki bad-aamali ka natija bhugatna padega aur jo sarkashiyan duniya mein ki hain sab ka maza chakhna padega. Bhala Allah ko na maanna aur buton ko maanna is se badh kar aur zulm kya hoga? Woh Aleem-o-Hakeem Allah uska badla diye baghair hargiz nahin rahega.

Maut ke baad kuffar ko azab aur mominon ko jannat. Mushrikon ka apni jahalat se azab-e-Ilahi talab karna bayan ho raha hai. Yeh Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) se bhi yahi kehte thay aur khud Allah Ta'ala se bhi yahi duayein karte thay ki janab-e-Bari agar yeh teri taraf se haq hai toh tu hum par aasman se patthar barsa ya hamein aur koi dardnak azab kar. Yahan unhein jawab milta hai ki Rabb-ul-Alameen yeh baat muqarrar kar chuka hai ki in kuffar ko Qayamat ke din azab honge, agar yeh na hota toh inke maangte hi azab ke maheeb badal in par baras padte. Jab Ikrimah toofan mein ghir gaye duniya ki haqarat-o-zillat uske zawal-o-fana ka zikr ho raha hai ke ise koi dawam nahin iska koi subaat nahin yeh toh sirf lahw-o-la'ab hai. Albatta dar-e-akhirat ki zindagi dawam-o-baqa ki zindagi hai woh zawal-o-fana se qillat-o-zillat se door hai. Agar inhe ilm hota toh is baqa wali cheez par is fani cheez ko tarjeeh na dete. Phir farmaya ke mushrikeen be-kasi aur be-basi ke waqt toh Allah Ta'ala wahdahu la sharika lahu ko hi pukarne lagte hain. Phir museebat ke hat jaane aur mushkil ke tal jaane ke baad uske sath dusron ka naam kyun lete hain? Jaise aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Wa iza massakumud durru fil bahri dalla man tad'una illa iyyah, falamma najjakum ilal barri a'radtum, wa kanal insanu kafoora) (17. Al-Isra: 67) yani jab samundar mein mushkil mein phans-te hain us waqt Allah ke siwa sab ko bhool jaate hain aur jab wahan se najaat paakar khushki mein aa jaate hain toh foran hi munh pher lete hain. Seerat-e-Ibn Ishaq mein hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makkah fatah kiya toh Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl yahan se bhaag nikla aur Habsha jaane ke irade se kashti mein baith gaya ittifaqan sakht toofan aaya aur kashti idhar udhar hone lagi. Jitne mushrikeen kashti mein the sab kehne lage yeh mauqa sirf Allah ko pukaarne ka hai utho aur khuloos ke sath Allah Ta'ala se duayein karo is waqt najaat isi ke hath hai. Yeh sunte hi Ikrimah ne kaha suno Allah ki qasam agar samundar ki is bala se siwaye Allah ke koi najaat nahin de sakta toh khushki ki museebaton ka taalnewala bhi wahi hai. Allah main tujh se ahd karta hoon ke agar main yahan se bach gaya toh seedha jaakar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath mein hath rakh dunga aur Aap ka kalma parh lunga. Mujhe yaqeen hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) meri khataon se darguzar farmalenge aur mujh par rahm-o-karam farmayenge chunancha yahi hua bhi. Aayat (liyakfuru) aur (liyatamatta'u) mein laam jo hai ise laam-e-aafiyat kehte hain is liye ke unka qasd darasal yeh nahin hota aur filwaq'a un ki taraf nazrein daalne se baat bhi yahi hai. Haan Allah Ta'ala ki nisbat se toh yeh laam-e-ta'leel hai. Is ki poori taqreer hum aayat (Faltaqatahu aalu fir'auna liyakuna lahum aduwwan wa hazana, inna fir'auna wa hamana wa junudahuma kanu khati'een) (28. Al-Qasas: 8) mein kar chuke hain.

Ahsan ke badle ahsan? Allah Ta'ala Quraish ko apna ahsan jatata hai ke usne apne haram mein unhein jagah di. Jo shakhs is mein aa jaye aman mein pahunch jata hai. Is ke aas paas jidal-o-qital loot maar hoti rehti hai aur yahan wale aman-o-aman se apne din guzarte hain. Jise Surah Li-Ilaf-e-Quraish al-kh mein bayan farmaya to kya is itni badi nemat ka shukriya yahi hai ke yeh Allah ke sath dusron ki bhi ibadat karein? Bajaye iman lane ke shirk karein aur khud tabah ho kar dusron ko bhi isi halakat wali rah le chalein. Lekin unhon ne is ke bar-aks Allah ke sath shirk-o-kufr karna aur Nabi (ﷺ) ko jhutlana aur eeza pahunchana shuru kar rakha hai. Apni sarkashi mein yahan tak badh gaye ke Allah ke paighambar ko Makkah se nikal diya. Bil-akhir Allah ki nematein un se chhinni shuru ho gayin. Badr ke din un ke bade buri tarah qatl hue. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ke hathon Makkah ko fatah kiya aur unhein zaleel-o-past kiya. Is se badh kar koi zalim nahin jo Allah par jhoot bandhe. Wahi aati na ho aur keh de ke meri taraf wahi ki jati hai aur is se bhi badh kar zalim koi nahin jo Allah ki sachi wahi ko jhutlaye aur bawajood haq pahunchne ke takzeeb par kamar-basta rahe. Aise muftari aur mukazzib log kafir hain aur un ka thikana jahannam hai. Rah-e-Allah mein mushaqqat karne wale se murad Rasool Allah (ﷺ), aap ke as-hab aur aap ke tabe-e-farman log hain jo Qayamat tak honge. Farmata hai ke hum in koshish aur justuju karne walon ki rahnumai karenge, duniya aur deen mein un ki rehbari karte rahenge. Hazrat Abu Abbas Hamadani farmate hain murad yeh hai ke jo log apne ilm par amal karte hain Allah unhein un umoor mein bhi hidayat deta hai jo un ke ilm mein nahin hote. Abu Sulaiman Darani se jab yeh zikr kiya jata hai to aap farmate hain ke jis ke dil mein koi baat paida ho go woh bhali baat ho taham use is par amal na karna chahiye jab tak Quran-o-Hadith se woh sabit na ho. Jab sabit ho amal karein. Aur Allah ki hamd karein ke jo us ke jee mein aata tha, wahi Quran-o-Hadith mein bhi nikla. Allah Ta'ala muhsineen ke sath hai. Hazrat Isa bin Maryam farmate hain ahsan is ka naam hai ke jo tere sath bad-sulooki kare to us ke sath nek sulook kare. Ahsan karne walon se ahsan karne ka naam ahsan nahin, wallahu a'lam.
